description: Plain-words explanation of one Ethereum or Base transaction: a one-line summary (swap, send, approval, bridge, deposit, NFT transfer, failed call), every token and NFT movement with symbols, the account's net change, approvals (incl. Permit2), protocols touched, and red flags: unlimited or wallet approvals, look-alike tokens, address-poisoning spam, failed calls. Handles smart-account (ERC-4337) and gasless USDC (EIP-3009 / x402) transactions. Costs $0.01 (x402, USDC).

hash.description: Transaction hash, 0x followed by 64 hex characters

name: explain_transaction
